newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.4 Oct 4 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.4 Oct 4 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) held at 104.4 in the week ended October 4, unchanged from a revised 104.4 in the previous week, ECRI said.

Mixed economic data kept the gauge unchanged, ECRI said. The growth rate of real estate loans increased, while industrial materials prices declined and the spread between th yields of 10-year and three-month Treasuries narrowed, it said.
"The gauge remains on a downward path, pointing to subdued inflation in the months ahead," said an ECRI report.
